_comments.analysis: Controls news analysis functionality using OpenRouter AI service
_comments.analysis.openrouter.enabled: Master switch for OpenRouter API calls. When false, no API calls are made and news analysis is skipped
_comments.analysis.openrouter.model: Optional: Override the AI model used for analysis. Defaults to environment variable OPENROUTER_MODEL or 'openrouter/auto'
_comments.analysis.openrouter.temperature: Optional: Override temperature for AI responses (0.0-2.0). Lower values = more deterministic responses
_comments.diff: Controls diff calculation mode: 'off' (disabled), 'iteration' (diff between consecutive iterations), 'day' (diff from 00:00)
_comments.diff_multiplier: Percentage (0-100) of how strongly the diff should influence portfolio allocation. 0 = no influence, 100 = full influence
